title: 第七章 罗家危机第八章 紫玉聚灵盏
content_zh:
城北码头，清江帮总堂。
徐海拱手，“乌先生，三日时间已到，请随本帮主去罗家，取那父子二人的通天骨！”
他笑容满面，心情大好。
“报！”
帮众快步进来，“外面来了一人，自称罗家罗冠，要求见帮主。”
徐海眉头一皱，旋即冷笑，“让他进来！”
这三日他没闲着，一直都在关注罗家。
罗振阳兄弟几人，匆忙出售、抵押产业，清江帮有意散播消息，各家联手压价，他暗中大赚一笔。
罗家，绝对凑不出一万两黄金！
原担心这小子会跑路，没想到他竟主动送上门来。
很快，罗冠大步而来。
徐海似笑非笑，“罗公子是来送钱的？”
罗冠淡淡道：“没错，乌先生也在，倒是简单了。”他取出金票，“黄金一万两，徐帮主若无异议，就把卖骨契约拿来吧。”
“什么？！”
徐海仔细检查，的确是一万两，脸色顿时阴沉下去！他认定罗家无力赔偿，再加上罗冠赌上自己的通天骨，才答应此事。
可现在，罗冠竟真拿出一万两金票……失算了！
罗冠大声道：“紫云斋信誉第一，徐帮主更是一言九鼎，肯定不会反悔，对吧？”
这小子，可恶！
见乌先生看来，徐海紧咬槽牙，“本帮主答应的事，绝不食言。”
“去，把契约拿来！”

有人领命而去，将一份契约交给罗冠，他确定没错后，取出火折子当场烧毁。
这一幕，让徐海眼角又是一跳。
罗冠拱手，“徐帮主、乌先生，事情已了结，告辞。”
乌先生起身，淡淡道：“既然契约解除，我也走了。”
他身影一闪，消失不见。
大长老沉声：“帮主，就这么算了？我们可是已经答应了……”
徐海挥手打断，冷笑道：“罗家若真能拿出黄金，这两日还用四处受气，低价抛卖产业？这小子身上必有大秘密！”他目露森然“大长老带人跟上去，把他抓回来！”
……
码头外，罗振山等人步伐沉重。
这两日他们四下奔波，出售家族产业，可面对各方刁难，距离一万两黄金还有很大差距。
期限已到，他们不知道今日会是怎样结果。
就在这时，一道身影迎面而来。
罗振山脸色一变，“罗冠，你怎么在这？”
旁边几人面露不满，若非这小子局势未必至此，惹下大祸不说，竟还敢跑到清江帮的地盘。
莫非，他又做了什么事？
罗振山也是这么想的，急忙道：“你见徐海了？”
罗冠见几人脸色，心下了然，“大伯不必担心，我赎回了父亲卖骨契约，当场焚毁。”
“此事，已彻底解决。“
罗振山瞪大眼，“你怎么做到的？”
罗冠道：“说来话长，我有事要出城一趟，日后再跟大伯解释。”

他拱手行礼，大步离去。
content_en:
City North Pier, Qingjiang Gang Headquarters.
Xu Hai held up his hand and said, "Mr. Wu, the three days are up. Please follow my gang leader to Luo's house to get the Heavenly Bones of the father and son!"
He was smiling and in a good mood.
"Report!"
The gang came quickly, "A man came outside, calling himself Luo Guan of the Luo family, and asked to see the gang leader."
Xu Hai frowned, then sneered, "Let him in!"
He has not been idle these three days, and has been paying attention to the Luo family.
The Luo Zhenyang brothers hurriedly sold and mortgaged the property. The Qingjiang Gang deliberately spread the news, and each family joined forces to lower the price. He secretly made a fortune.
The Luo family will never be able to raise ten thousand taels of gold!
I was worried that this kid would run away, but I didn't expect that he would take the initiative to send me to my door.
Soon, Luo Guan strode over.
Xu Hai smiled half-heartedly, "Master Luo, are you here to give money?"
Luo Guan said calmly: "Yes, Mr. Wu is here, it's easy." He took out the gold ticket, "Ten thousand taels of gold. If Gang Leader Xu has no objection, just bring the bone sale contract."
"What?!"
Xu Hai checked carefully and found that it was indeed ten thousand taels, and his face suddenly darkened! He decided that the Luo family was unable to compensate, and because Luo Guan bet his own Heavenly Bones, he agreed to the matter.
But now, Luo Guan actually took out 10,000 taels of gold tickets... It was a miscalculation!
Luo Guan said loudly: "Ziyunzhai has the best reputation, and Gang Leader Xu is true to his word. He will definitely not go back on his words, right?"
This kid is disgusting!
Seeing Mr. Wu, Xu Hai gritted his teeth and said, "This gang leader will never break his promise."
"Go and get the contract!"
Someone followed the order and handed a contract to Luo Guan. After he was sure it was correct, he took out the fire certificate and burned it on the spot.
This scene made Xu Hai's eyes jump again.
Luo Guan cupped his hands and said, "Gang Leader Xu, Mr. Wu, the matter has been settled. Let's take our leave."
Mr. Wu stood up and said calmly: "Since the contract has been terminated, I will leave."
His figure flashed and disappeared.
The Great Elder said solemnly: "Gang Leader, just forget it like this? We have already agreed..."
Xu Hai waved his hand to interrupt and said with a sneer: "If the Luo family can really come up with gold, how can they spend the past two days taking advantage of others and selling off their property at a low price? There must be a big secret in this kid!" His eyes were serious. "The elder will lead people to follow and capture him!"
…
Outside the pier, Luo Zhenshan and others walked heavily.
In the past two days, they have been running around selling the family property, but they have faced difficulties from all sides, and there is still a long way to go before they can get 10,000 taels of gold.
The deadline has expired, and they don't know what the outcome will be today.
At this moment, a figure came towards him.
Luo Zhenshan's expression changed, "Luo Guan, why are you here?"
Several people nearby showed dissatisfaction. If it hadn't been for this kid, the situation might not have reached this point. Not only would he have caused a big disaster, he would have dared to run into the Qingjiang Gang's territory.
Could it be that he did something else?
Luo Zhenshan thought the same way and said hurriedly: "Have you met Xu Hai?"
Seeing the expressions on several people's faces, Luo Guan became convinced, "Don't worry, uncle. I redeemed my father's bone-selling contract and burned it on the spot."
"This matter has been completely resolved."
Luo Zhenshan's eyes widened, "How did you do it?"
Luo Guandao: "It's a long story. I have something to go out of the city for. I'll explain it to my uncle later."
He bowed his hands and strode away.
